After facing criticism over a lack of early intervention, the government has now launched an emergency response to contain a surging dengue outbreak. The Union Territory has recorded over 1,510 dengue cases till November this year, compared to 902 and 128 cases registered in 2025 and 2024, respectively.

stories.title: 56 fall ill after eating shawarma; Bhiwandi civic body cracks down on illegal stalls
stories.summary: A day after 56 people, including a pregnant woman and 17 children, were hospitalised with suspected food poisoning after consuming chicken shawarma from a roadside stall in Bhiwandi, the Bhiwandi-Nizampur Municipal Corporation (BNMC) on Wednesday launched a special drive against unauthorised food stalls across the city. On Wednesday, civic officials removed several stalls in Vanjar Patti Naka, including the one from which the affected people had purchased the shawarma.

stories.title: Mindfulness linked to healthier social media use, better mental health: study
stories.summary: People with higher levels of mindfulness are more likely to have healthier social media habits and better mental health outcomes, according to a review of 43 studies involving more than 28,000 participants. Mindfulness involves observing one’s thoughts and feelings without judgement.

stories.title: New 250-bed district hospital to be inaugurated in Hosapete tomorrow
stories.summary: m. T. Khader will inaugurate the hospital, according to a press release issued by the district administration and the Department of Health and Family Welfare. S. Basavanthappa will be present on the occasion. T. Parameshwar Naik will also attend. R. Gaviappa will preside over the programme. Comments have to be in English, and in full sentences.

stories.title: Bandi Sanjay seeks crackdown on drug mafia, questions action on key cases
stories.summary: Alleging that criminal gangs profiting from drug trafficking were “enemies of society”, he called for stringent action against drug suppliers and their financial networks. He questioned what had happened to the investigations into major drug cases, including the widely publicised 2017 drugs case, and asked whether influential persons allegedly linked to such cases had been brought to justice.

stories.title: 100-bed cancer hospital coming up in North Andhra
stories.summary: Divyaamrita Sai, founder of the Sri Sathya Sai Divyaamritam Trust said that the trust is constructing a 100-bed cancer cure hospital and 30-bed dialysis center for kidney patients at Thatipudi in Vizianagaram district to provide affordable treatment to patients from the North Andhra region. He was speaking after inaugurating the ‘Nidaan’ Centre for Studies on Cancer and Kidney Diseases in Vizianagaram.

stories.title: Mumbai: Cama Hospital’s Dr Tushar Palve Honoured By MOGS For Contribution To Medical Education And Public
stories.summary: He established Maharashtra's first government ART/IVF centre at Cama Hospital, making infertility treatment more affordable for economically weaker patients. He also set up the state's first urogynaecology department and fellowship programme in a government hospital, introducing specialised facilities such as video urodynamics, 3D pelvic floor ultrasonography and laser treatment.

stories.title: Two-thirds of adolescents in India are deficient in vitamin B12: ICMR survey
stories.summary: Nearly two-thirds of Indian adolescents are deficient in vitamin B12, a micronutrient essential for brain development, healthy nerve function, and the formation of red blood cells, according to a new national survey by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR). The findings raise concerns about the long-term consequences of nutritional deficiencies across generations, particularly among children, adolescents, and pregnant women.

stories.title: Pregnant US inmate escapes in prison vehicle after medical appointment
stories.summary: A pregnant inmate has escaped from custody in the US state of New Mexico, after taking control of a police vehicle while returning to prison from a prenatal appointment, the state's corrections department has said. Rebecca Taylor, 26, took control of the Dodge Journey and drove away when the team transporting her and another inmate stopped to pick up food in Albuquerque, local media reported.

stories.title: Carbohydrate quality, not quantity, must drive future nutrition research, says CFTRI chief
stories.summary: Beyond the conventional criticism of carbohydrates, Giridhar Parvatam, Director, CSIR-Central Food Technological Research Institute (CFTRI), Mysuru, called for a holistic approach to carbohydrate quality, food processing, and consumer health, and stressed the importance of whole grains, dietary fibre, and minimally processed plant foods. Pointing out that carbohydrates are frequently criticised despite the nutritional benefits they offer, Mr.

stories.title: Karnataka can independently benchmark drug regulatory system against WHO standards: Union Health Secretary
stories.summary: Union Health Secretary Punya Salila Srivastava on Thursday (November 26) suggested that progressive States such as Karnataka could independently benchmark their drug regulatory systems against the World Health Organization’s (WHO) maturity-level requirements, instead of waiting for the entire country to achieve the required standards. She was addressing food and drug regulators in Karnataka at a national-level conference on Food Safety and Drug Administration organised by the State Health Department in Bengaluru.

stories.title: Village Health Nurses oppose appointment on contract basis; seek periodic promotion
stories.summary: Village Health Nurses (VHNs) staged a demonstration here on Thursday in protest against the appointment of nurses in the health sub-centres on contract basis and seeking promotions based on their seniority. The protesting Village Health Nurses said the system of appointing nurses in the health sub-centres on contract basis should be given-up as this arrangement has diluted the quality of work to a greater extent.

stories.title: Expired food, mouldy sugarcane seized during surprise inspections in Kozhikode
stories.summary: The health squad of the Kozhikode Corporation seized expired food products and mould-infested sugarcane during surprise inspections at hotels and eateries across the city on Thursday (November 26, 2026). , found several violations of food safety and sanitation norms, including storage of perishable ingredients in unhygienic freezers and poorly maintained kitchens.

stories.title: Is your stomach discomfort hiding cancer? A surgical oncologist shares 3 warning signs that you can't ignore
stories.summary: Stomach cancer, also known as gastric cancer, often develops gradually and may not produce noticeable symptoms during its early stages. One of the biggest challenges in diagnosing the disease is that its initial symptoms can resemble common digestive problems such as acidity, gastritis, bloating or indigestion.

stories.title: Litchfield stars as Thunder beat Strikers in record run-fest
stories.summary: Litchfield made 121 not out as Thunder held on against Strikers in WBBL record 473-run thriller at North Sydney Oval

stories.title: IND vs NZL Second Test Day 1: India wins toss, elects to bowl first
stories.summary: Shubman Gill completed a clean sweep of tosses as the India captain had no hesitation in opting to bowl first on a bright and sunny morning at the Hagley Oval. Gurnoor Brar, the debutant who came in for Prasidh Krishna, will hope to make the most of the early moisture.

stories.title: 2036 Olympics bid: India to make presentation to IOC
stories.summary: Union sports minister Mansukh Mandaviya and outgoing Indian Olympic Association (IOA) president PT Usha will head the country’s delegation that will discuss India's 2036 Olympic bid with officials of the International Olympic Committee (IOC) on Thursday.

stories.title: World Chess Championship: Nothing to separate Gukesh, Sindarov after three games
stories.summary: During an interview a couple of years ago, former World Rapid Chess Champion Daniil Dubov made an interesting remark about D. Gukesh. “When he is at his best, he plays only the best moves – just like a chess engine,” the Russian Grandmaster had told this correspondent.

stories.title: India v New Zealand Test: Shubman Gill’s character as captain on Test
stories.summary: Shubman Gill would be left with bitter recollections of having to close back-to-back Tests with part-timers Dhruv Jurel and Yashasvi Jaiswal. Even though momentarily it is all fun and games when batters are bowling dollies to bring a closure to a no-result Test, in effect, it means the bowlers have conceded their inability to force a victory.

stories.title: India presents 2036 Olympic vision to IOC Future Host Commission in virtual meeting
stories.summary: The Indian delegation was led by Indian Olympic Association (IOA) president PT Usha, CEO Raghuram Iyer and IOA Athletes’ Commission chairperson PV Sindhu. Ahmedabad is at the centre of India’s proposed hosting model, with the city set to host the 2030 Commonwealth Games. The presentation highlighted Ahmedabad’s infrastructure readiness and the support extended by city, state and central authorities.

stories.title: The making of Gurnoor Brar: How raw pace took the lanky pacer to India Test debut
stories.summary: On Friday, Brar took another big step in his cricketing journey, earning a maiden Test cap in Christchurch . It is an opportunity that has been years in the making, and those who watched him grow up as a cricketer know that the story behind it goes well beyond his towering frame.

stories.title: ‘Check the weight of balls too’: Deepak Chahar tells authorities
stories.summary: "Overall, the ball is swinging a little less these days, whether in the IPL, domestic cricket or any other game. I suddenly found out that the ball has a lot of weight. About a month back, one day I just happened to check the weight of 15 new (Kookaburra) balls.

stories.title: Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy: Azharuddeen’s century powers Kerala into the Super League
stories.summary: Mohammed Azharuddeen’s signature rocking-the-bat celebration has become a defining moment in this season’s Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy T20 cricket tournament. The opening batter brought it out once again on Friday for his second T20 hundred (101, 57b, 8x4, 6x6) which dismantled Himachal Pradesh and helped Kerala register a 67-run win to qualify for the Super League.

stories.title: If Mohammed Siraj is world-class, why is he out?
stories.summary: “For me, he is bowling well. He is a world-class bowler. “The conversation I had with him was: ‘Listen, let’s strip it back a little bit. Where are we at the moment? “Selection is something we can’t really control. All we can control is putting our energy into the guys who are playing,” he said.

stories.title: Glenn makes 'free ball' history in WBBL after Dottin timed out
stories.summary: Watch the moment England's Sarah Glenn makes history in the women's Big Bash League as she bowls at an empty set of stumps with a 'free ball', to dismiss Deandra Dottin after the batter was ruled to have taken too long to face the delivery.

stories.title: 'All the way': Sindhu eyes historic Uber Cup triumph as India gets 2028 hosting rights
stories.summary: Sindhu was part of the Indian women's squad that created history by securing the country's first-ever Uber Cup medal, a bronze, when New Delhi hosted the tournament in 2014. "I was proud of the bronze we won in Delhi in 2014. If I get another chance to play the Uber Cup at home, I want us to go all the way.

stories.title: Champions League: Man United and PSG held to draws, Bayern loses
stories.summary: Mauricio Pochettino was denied his first win as Manchester United coach in calamitous circumstances after a 2-2 draw with Sporting Lisbon in the Champions League. Paris Saint-Germain was held to the same scoreline by Roma, ending the back-to-back defending champion's 100% winning record and leaving Real Madrid out in front at the top of the standings.

stories.title: Bournemouth 'allowed to dream' as fans book Europa League final hotels
stories.summary: Bournemouth are dreaming of winning the Europa League after staging a 10-man fightback to join a select band of teams to win their first five European games. The Cherries trailed 1-0 to Iago Aspas' goal at Celta Vigo, and then went down to 10 men midway through the first half when Bafode Diakite was sent off.

stories.title: Jannik Sinner out of Australian Open 2027 due to knee injury
stories.summary: Jannik Sinner won't compete in the first Grand Slam tennis tournament of 2027 while he recovers from recent right knee surgery, Australian Open officials said on Thursday (November 26, 2026). “We've been in regular touch with Jannik's team and they've confirmed he won't be joining us for the AO in January following his recent surgery,” Tennis Australia chief executive Andrew Abdo said in a statement to The Associated Press .

stories.title: Former England scrum-half and commentator Starmer-Smith dies aged 81
stories.summary: Former England scrum-half and rugby union commentator Nigel Starmer-Smith has died aged 81. Starmer-Smith represented Harlequins and the Barbarians, and made seven appearances for England between 1969-71. After his retirement in 1976, Starmer-Smith moved into broadcasting and journalism. He voiced the BBC's highlights programme Rugby Special for 15 years and commentated for ITV at the 2003 World Cup in Australia, won by England.

stories.title: Selby faces tough UK Championship opener, with Allen set to feature
stories.summary: Four-time world champion Mark Selby will begin his defence of the UK Championship title against Matt Selt on Saturday at York Barbican. It represents a tough opening match for Selby, with fellow Englishman Selt having beaten world number 17 Jak Jones, the highest-ranked player in the qualifiers, to reach the televised stages.

stories.title: Clashes at Besiktas match against Israeli club spark diplomatic row
stories.summary: Istanbul club Besiktas's supporters unfurled a pro-Palestinian banner during a UEFA Europa League match against Israeli side Hapoel Beer-Sheva in Georgia on Thursday (November 26, 2026), prompting a police response and sparking a diplomatic incident that led Turkey's foreign minister to contact his Georgian counterpart. Turkish football fans clashed with police in Batumi, temporarily halting the match, which had been moved from Istanbul over security concerns.

stories.title: Indian-origin footballer Krissh Mahatma, 18, shot dead outside US restaurant
stories.summary: Krissh Mahatma had moved from London to the United States to pursue a football career and was only three months into his first season with the Co-Lin Wolves when his life was cut short. The 18-year-old striker was shot dead outside a taco restaurant in Jackson, Mississippi, after an argument involving a group of people reportedly escalated into gunfire.

stories.title: Aaron Rodgers enters free agency after going unclaimed on waivers following Steelers release
stories.summary: Aaron Rodgers went unclaimed on waivers Thursday, becoming a free agent a day after the Pittsburgh Steelers released the veteran quarterback, who has announced that this will be his final NFL season. NFL insider Ian Rapoport reported the development on Thursday. He tweeted on X, "Aaron Rodgers has cleared waivers and is a free agent."

stories.title: 43 WTC wickets, still benched: Mohammed Siraj overlooked again as India hand Gurnoor Brar debut cap in 2nd Test against New Zealand
stories.summary: Fast bowler Gurnoor Brar made his Test debut in the second Test against New Zealand in Christchurch on Friday. Gurnoor replaced Prasidh Krishna in the playing XI as India captain Shubman Gill won the toss and elected to bowl on a green top at the Hagley Oval.

stories.title: NZ vs IND: No Siraj again, Gurnoor makes Test debut as India drop Prasidh Krishna
stories.summary: India captain Shubman Gill won the toss and opted to bowl first at Hagley Oval, with the visitors hoping to make early use of the moisture in the pitch. Gurnoor's inclusion adds extra pace to an attack that will once again be led by Bumrah. Siraj's absence is a notable one given his record in overseas conditions.

stories.title: Jadeja, Siraj left out yet again! Gurnoor makes Test debut as India opt to bowl
stories.summary: India have made just one change to their playing XI, handing a Test debut to pacer Gurnoor Brar, who replaces Prasidh Krishna. There is no place for Ravindra Jadeja and Mohammed Siraj once again, with India continuing to back Washington Sundar in the playing XI.

stories.title: Jerry Jones and Jeffrey Lurie share a warm moment before Cowboys vs Eagles Thanksgiving Day clash
stories.summary: NFL on Thanksgiving Day 2026 will witness one of the biggest rivalries of the NFC East unfold as the Dallas Cowboys take on the Philadelphia Eagles in Arlington, Texas . But aside from the on-field rivalry, the two teams' owners were at AT&T Stadium on Thursday evening and shared a warm moment on the field minutes before kickoff.

stories.title: Jaydev Unadkat scripts history with stunning No. 11 knock, smashes T20 world record
stories.summary: In an extraordinary display of resilience, Jaydev Unadkat smashed 40 runs while batting at No. 11 in a T20 match, setting a new record that eclipsed the former high of 35 runs. His partnership with Chetan Sakariya yielded an impressive 62 runs for the 10th wicket. Unfortunately, their valiant effort was not enough, as Saurashtra fell to Tamil Nadu by 38 runs, thus eliminating their Super League aspirations.

stories.title: Sahiba Bali's Gurpurab post with Arjun Kapoor sparks dating buzz, fans wonder 'is it a soft launch?'
stories.summary: Dating lives of celebrities are something every entertainment junkie is deeply interested in. And, with the strong presence of social media, fans often get to know about the whereabouts of their favourite actors. Something similar happened recently when actor and sports presenter Sahiba Bali uploaded a photo with actor Arjun Kapoor.

stories.title: India's top court tightens food warning labels in ne
stories.summary: NEW DELHI, - India's top court ruled on Thursday that separate warning labels should appear on the front of food packaging for every nutrient of concern, tightening a government proposal that called for a single label and dealing a blow to the $100 billion industry that has long opposed the measure.

stories.title: When will Poundland shops close? Five key questions answered
stories.summary: Poundland has collapsed into administration, leaving the jobs of its 11,000 staff in doubt in the run-up to Christmas. The company has appointed consultancy Alix Partners to oversee a sale of part or all of the discount retailer, with questions remaining about the future of the company. Poundland collapsing has acted as a reset of the process of selling the company.

stories.title: Explained: What is ‘Starmind’? SpaceX gets FCC nod for 1 million space-based data centres - Full details
stories.summary: SpaceX has received approval from the US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) to deploy up to 1 million orbital computing modules for a proposed constellation of space-based data centres, marking a major push to take artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure beyond Earth.

stories.title: Explainer-Spain’s snap election — why it matters and who might win?
stories.summary: MADRID, Nov 26 (Reuters) – Spain goes to the polls on Sunday in an early parliamentary election that may usher in a right-wing coalition to replace the Socialist-led minority government of Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez, one of Europe’s last leftist leaders. Sanchez called the election after parliament on October 2 rejected his decrees to address growing anger over rising rents and evictions.

stories.title: Who Is Vardhaman Jain? Chennai Businessman Offers 121 Kg Gold Ornaments Worth ₹206 Cr To Lord Venkateswara
stories.summary: Chennai-based industrialist and philanthropist Vardhaman Jain has made a significant religious contribution by donating 121 kg of gold ornaments valued at ₹160 crore to the Tirumala Temple in Andhra Pradesh. Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu visited the temple on Thursday, Nov 26, to attend the formal handover ceremony.

stories.title: Knowledge Nugget | EPFO’s new rules explained: From easier PF withdrawals to payout plan for retirees
stories.summary: The Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), at the meeting of its Central Board of Trustees (CBT) on November 19, 2026, approved key changes to Provident Fund (PF) withdrawal rules. These include reducing the waiting period for final PF settlement after unemployment from 12 months to two months, lowering the minimum balance that members must retain in their accounts from 25% to 10%, and introducing a Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP).

stories.title: In a nation of chai drinkers, Darjeeling’s prized tea is a sliver of the crop. Its history and troubles | HT Explainers
stories.summary: Union commerce and industry minister Piyush Goyal said last week the government was working to restore the glory of Darjeeling tea – the first Indian product to win a geographical indication (GI) tag – at a time when the hills are growing less tea than they did a generation ago and the industry is struggling.

stories.title: Is a proof enough if it isn't beautiful?
stories.summary: On 20 November, Levent Alpöge, a mathematician at Anthropic, posted a short note on his personal website. “I believe I have, working with Claude, discovered a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis,” he wrote. For the uninitiated, the Riemann Hypothesis is a 167-year-old conjecture about the distribution of prime numbers.

stories.title: Maharashtra's new property card plan: What flat owners, homebuyers need to know
stories.summary: The Maharashtra government has proposed issuing separate property cards for individual flats in buildings, recording ownership details, sanctioned area, associated rights, mortgages and other liabilities. The proposed system, called the Vertical Property Card, aims to create an independent supplementary record of rights for every eligible flat or unit, alongside existing land records.

stories.title: Can charity money be used to fight Tata Sons listing? Vijay Singh seeks urgent probe
stories.summary: VETO Sayantani Biswas Published 26 Nov 2026, 10:04 PM IST Prefer Livemint on Google A fresh rift within the Tata Trusts has brought the group's charitable finances into focus, with trustee Vijay Singh questioning whether funds meant for public welfare could be used to finance a legal battle that may delay Tata Sons' stock market listing.
